ArtSource.description: Existing art to preview a frame on: a draft's render, or a sample's.
ArtSource.title: ArtSource

AutoCheck.description: What auto-moderation found for the current image. ``passed`` recorded the moderator's approval.
AutoCheck.title: AutoCheck

Background.description: One rendered background and its review. ``status`` is ``pending`` until the moderator decides.
Background.title: Background

BackgroundDecision.description: POST /projects/{id}/backgrounds/{bg}/review: the moderator's decision on one background.
BackgroundDecision.title: BackgroundDecision

BackgroundJob.description: The last rendering job for a set. A job left queued or running by a restart reads as failed.
BackgroundJob.title: BackgroundJob

BackgroundReview.description: The moderator's decision on one background image, bound to its sha256.
BackgroundReview.title: BackgroundReview

BackgroundSet.description: ``manifest.json``: the backgrounds of one scene version.
BackgroundSet.title: BackgroundSet

BackgroundSetList.description: GET /projects/{id}/backgrounds: each scene version's backgrounds, by scene then version.
BackgroundSetList.title: BackgroundSetList

BioRecord.description: The bio written for this card: its template and model, the text, and every attempt.
BioRecord.title: BioRecord

BioRef.description: The reviewed bio template (and model) that wrote the card's bio (see :mod:`argus_mint.bios`).
BioRef.title: BioRef

BioTemplate.description: One version of a bio template, as reviewed and recorded in its YAML file.
BioTemplate.title: BioTemplate

Capabilities.description: What this server will do. A client disables a control whose capability is false.
Capabilities.title: Capabilities

CardDraft.description:
Everything needed to publish a card, except the pins and the signature.

``kind`` is ``card`` (a game card: ``asset_id``, ``consumer``, maybe a bio) or ``teaser``
(an image and quote from a teaser project: ``teaser`` records what made it, and it has no
asset id, consumer or bio). Both are reviewed the same way; ``to`` is the owner who signs.
CardDraft.title: CardDraft

CardStyle.description: The owner's styling of a framed card: any colours, so be it if that's black on black.
CardStyle.title: CardStyle

ChallengeRequest.description:
POST /drafts/{id}/challenge: the owner asks for the message to sign.

``action: review`` with ``approve``; ``action: edit`` with the exact ``edit`` it will authorise.
ChallengeRequest.title: ChallengeRequest

CreateDraft.description:
POST /drafts. The template, frame and bio are named by id and version, never by path.

Either render (``variables``, ``seed``, optionally ``model``), or take a pre-rendered
``library`` entry, whose variables, seed and checkpoint then apply.
CreateDraft.title: CreateDraft

CreateTeaserDraft.description: POST /projects/{id}/teasers/{n}/draft. Everything else comes from the project's reviewed files.
CreateTeaserDraft.title: CreateTeaserDraft

DraftPosts.description: A draft's posts, in the order recorded (the answer to POST /drafts/{id}/posted).
DraftPosts.title: DraftPosts

Edit.description: A change to the card's text, which redraws the card image on the same art.
Edit.title: Edit

EditTextRequest.description:
POST /drafts/{id}/edit: only the owner edits, with the signed challenge for exactly this edit.

The moderator approves or rejects; they don't change the card.
EditTextRequest.title: EditTextRequest

FailedBackground.description:
A background that made no image. ``final``: the safety check refused every attempt, so
rendering it again would only repeat them; otherwise an error stopped it and a new job retries.
FailedBackground.title: FailedBackground

FailedCandidate.description: A candidate that made no image. ``final``: the safety check refused every attempt.
FailedCandidate.title: FailedCandidate

Frame.description: One version of a frame, as reviewed and recorded in its YAML file.
Frame.title: Frame

FramePreviewRequest.description: POST /frames/{id}/{version}/preview: a frame (any status) on existing art; returns a PNG.
FramePreviewRequest.title: FramePreviewRequest

FrameRef.description: The reviewed frame composited onto the render (see :mod:`argus_mint.frames`).
FrameRef.title: FrameRef

IdentityTrainingView.description:
GET /projects/{id}/identities/{identity}/{version}/training: the record, and each step's status
as mint works it out (a job a restart cut off reads as failed). ``next``: the one step the
moderator may start now, if any.
IdentityTrainingView.title: IdentityTrainingView

InitImageRef.description:
An inpainting (or image-to-image) input, by hash: the bytes travel beside the request.

``sha256`` is of the image bytes sent and ``mask_sha256`` of the mask's (white repaints,
black keeps); darkroom's record names both as ``source_sha256``, and the client checks them.
InitImageRef.title: InitImageRef

LayoutRequest.description: POST /frames/{id}/{version}/layout: where these texts go, for a browser preview.
LayoutRequest.title: LayoutRequest

LibraryListing.description: GET /library: pre-rendered portraits, for drafts without a GPU (``CreateDraft.library``).
LibraryListing.title: LibraryListing

LoraChoice.description: A render's pick from the template's ``lora_options``. ``weight`` defaults to the first allowed.
LoraChoice.title: LoraChoice

LoraOption.description:
A LoRA a card may choose (reviewed with the template), at one of its allowed weights.

``models``: the checkpoints it may pair with (a LoRA belongs to one family); empty means any
the template allows.
LoraOption.title: LoraOption

LoraRef.description:
A LoRA by file name, with its weight and the trigger words the renderer appends.

A bare string in YAML means ``{name: <string>, weight: 1.0}``.
LoraRef.title: LoraRef

Post.description:
One posting of a draft's image, as reported by whoever posted it (argus-herald).

``sha256`` is of the bytes that were posted, and must be the draft's ``image_sha256``: a teaser
PNG is baked with no metadata chunks, so a copy stripped of metadata hashes the same.
``by`` says which token recorded it.
Post.title: Post

PostRequest.description:
POST /drafts/{id}/posted: a post of an approved teaser's image (poster or moderator token).

``sha256`` is of the bytes posted and must equal the draft's ``image_sha256``.
PostRequest.title: PostRequest

ProjectChecks.description:
What stands between a project's files and approval.

``spoiler_rules`` are numbers in the private spoiler list, never its terms. ``guard_ran`` is
false when no darkroom is configured: then nothing can be approved.
ProjectChecks.title: ProjectChecks

ProjectDetail.description:
GET /projects/{id}: every file of a project (teaser links included, kind ``teasers``) and their checks.

``checks.guard`` holds the verdicts stored in the files that still hold; a text with none
hasn't been checked since it (or the project's policy) last changed.
ProjectDetail.title: ProjectDetail

ProjectTracker.description: GET /projects/{id}/tracker: each teaser of the newest approved links (none: ``links_version`` null).
ProjectTracker.title: ProjectTracker

ReadyTeaser.description:
One approved teaser, as GET /posts/ready lists it for a poster (argus-herald).

``image_url`` is the draft's image route, relative to argus-mint's base URL; its bytes hash to
``image_sha256``. ``posted`` is true once a post is recorded; such a teaser stays listed.
``current`` is false for a draft made from another line, identity or scene than the
project's current teaser links name for that number (a newer draft supersedes it).
ReadyTeaser.title: ReadyTeaser

ReadyTeasers.description: GET /posts/ready: approved (and published) teaser drafts, newest first, paged.
ReadyTeasers.title: ReadyTeasers

RenderRequest.description:
Everything a renderer needs, fully determined by template version + values + seed.

A teaser's renders are not of a template: a background's ``template_*`` name its scene, and
an inpainted figure's name its identity (each file's id, version and hash). ``init_image``
is set only for an inpainted figure.
RenderRequest.title: RenderRequest

ReviewRequest.description:
POST /drafts/{id}/review.

The moderator sends ``Authorization: Bearer <token>`` and ``by``; the owner sends the
signed challenge (``message`` + ``signature``), and ``by`` is their address.
ReviewRequest.title: ReviewRequest

SampleRequest.description: POST /samples: render sample cards of a template (any status) for its reviewer.
SampleRequest.title: SampleRequest

Sampling.description: Sampler settings, fixed by the reviewed template so a render is reproducible.
Sampling.title: Sampling

SaveProjectFile.description:
POST /projects/{id}/files/{kind}/{item}/{version}: write a draft file.

``doc`` is the file's content without ``status``, ``approved_by`` or ``approved_at``: a saved
file is always a draft, and ``guard`` is written by the server alone. An approved or
retired file never changes; save a new version.
SaveProjectFile.title: SaveProjectFile

Selection.description: Curator's pick, split by mint. Files are candidate files; the two sets never share one.
Selection.title: Selection

SlotBackground.description: A filled, rounded box behind a text slot.
SlotBackground.title: SlotBackground

SlotStyle.description: How one text slot is drawn. Unset fields keep the frame's own choices.
SlotStyle.title: SlotStyle

StepRun.description: One run of one step: what it was given, which sibling run or scan it made, what came of it.
StepRun.title: StepRun

TeaserBackground.description: The approved background a teaser was made on.
TeaserBackground.title: TeaserBackground

TeaserDraftState.description:
One teaser draft, as the tracker lists it. ``current``: made from the current links' line,
identity and scene (an older draft of the same number may not be).
TeaserDraftState.title: TeaserDraftState

TeaserFile.description: A reviewed project file a teaser was made from, by id, version and hash (0x keccak256).
TeaserFile.title: TeaserFile

TeaserRecord.description:
What a teaser draft was made from: its project, number, each linked file and the background.

The frame is the draft's own ``frame``. The quote, attribution and label drawn on it are the
draft's ``texts`` (by slot), from the reviewed line and project, never edited.
TeaserRecord.title: TeaserRecord

TeaserStages.description: The stages a teaser has reached, as argus-mint works them out (a client never does).
TeaserStages.title: TeaserStages

Template.description: One version of a render template, as reviewed and recorded in its YAML file.
Template.title: Template

TemplateCheck.description:
GET /templates/{id}/{version}/check: what would make darkroom refuse to render the template.

Checked against darkroom's model list: checkpoints, LoRAs, sampler and scheduler exist, and a
workflow renders each checkpoint with every LoRA count the template allows, taking what the
template sends. Approving a template is refused while ``problems`` isn't empty.
TemplateCheck.title: TemplateCheck

TextCheck.description:
SingGuard's verdict on one text, under the project's policy (darkroom's text pre-flight).

The verdict is stored in the file's ``guard`` block and holds while the text and the policy
are the ones it judged.
TextCheck.title: TextCheck

TextEdit.description:
The owner's change to the card: text and style. ``None`` leaves a field as it is; an empty
slot text clears it; ``style`` replaces the whole style (an empty one clears it).
TextEdit.title: TextEdit

TextSlot.description:
A box for one piece of card text.

The text is drawn at ``size`` if it fits, else at the largest size down to ``min_size``
that fits; with ``wrap`` it breaks across lines. If it doesn't fit even at ``min_size``,
it is clipped and ends in an ellipsis.
TextSlot.title: TextSlot

Tint.description: Recolour the frame overlay: every pixel moves toward ``colour`` at its own brightness.
Tint.title: Tint

TrainingRecord.description: ``record.json``: one identity version's training, every step run kept.
TrainingRecord.title: TrainingRecord
